description: Propose regions to redact for a PERSON to accept in the Omitly desktop app (omitly#1643, bring your own AI). The explicit, preferred form for agents working alongside a lawyer: nothing is written by this call. The desktop app shows the proposal, the person accepts or rejects, and on acceptance Omitly removes the content, checks the file for copies left behind and seals the output with a record that a person decided. Requires the Omitly desktop app to be running on this computer; use get_proposal_status to follow the outcome. Same inputs as redact_pdf (a region `reason` may not be AI_PROPOSAL, MANUAL or OCR_CORRECTED: those words are reserved for what a person decides, and the request is refused). The regions must come from a scan of this document: pass the analysisId that find_sensitive_regions or locate_text returned with them. Nothing is uploaded.

analysisId.description: the analysisId returned by find_sensitive_regions or locate_text for THIS document; required when the Omitly desktop app is running and the regions would be queued for a person to accept (it ties the coordinates to the bytes you scanned); ignored otherwise

outputPath.description: your suggested path for the redacted PDF; the person picks the real one in Omitly's save dialog

pdfPath.description: absolute path to the source PDF

reason.description: audit-log reason, e.g. 'PII: SSN'. Never AI_PROPOSAL, MANUAL or OCR_CORRECTED (before any | or =>, in any case): those words are reserved for what a person decided in the Omitly app, and a request that uses one is refused

name: propose_redactions
